summary: This document describes a blockchain/smart contract escrow liquidity verification methodology, outlining four on-chain reads used to confirm that committed funds in an escrow contract can actually be paid out. It includes a counter-example demonstrating a failure mode and a reporting standard. This is entirely unrelated to biotech, life sciences, or any technology relevant to TRL assessment of a therapeutic or scientific project.

content_blocks.title: Escrow Liquidity Check Methodology
content_blocks.content: The document describes a blockchain escrow verification process using four on-chain reads (eth_call at commitment block, eth_call at current head, locked liquidity read, and eth_getTransactionReceipt). It includes a counter-example where a balance check passed but funds could not be moved due to an unfunded withdrawal path. It also defines a reporting standard for on-chain vs. inferred values, gas reporting, payer identification, and handling of unavailable reads. Commercial pricing terms and a USDC settlement address are listed. No scientific, biomedical, or therapeutic content is present.
